backend/main.mo: Motoko backend storing contact form submissions in a list and exposing methods to submit and retrieve them.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping specified UI features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for various frontend components, hooks, utilities, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining CSS variables for themes and applying background and foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document setting metadata and loading the React application root and entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component assembling all site sections, theme provider, floating CTA, and UI toaster.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section with team image, company description, feature cards, and CTA buttons for contact and WhatsApp.
frontend/src/components/Certificates.tsx: Certificates section displaying the Udyam Registration Certificate with preview, details, and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/Contact.tsx: A contact section with a form, quick call/WhatsApp CTAs, and mapped contact info blocks, submitting via a custom mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Displays floating call and WhatsApp buttons that appear after scrolling and open phone or WhatsApp actions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A footer with company info, navigation links, contact details, and a dynamic copyright line.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A fixed header with scroll effects, top contact bar, navigation links, mobile menu handling, and WhatsApp actions.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: A hero section with branding, AMC highlight, descriptive text, and buttons for quoting or WhatsApp messaging.
frontend/src/components/Products.tsx: Defines product data with price formatting and renders product cards linking to WhatsApp and other actions.
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Displays core and additional electrical services with icons, descriptions, images, and WhatsApp/contact actions.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Renders customer testimonials with star ratings and styled review cards.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Initializes and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, managing login, stored identities, and auth client setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines react-query hooks for submitting and retrieving contact form submissions through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with theme variables, dark mode styles, utilities, and scroll/animation rules.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports business branding constants including name, city, and header tagline.
frontend/src/lib/scroll.ts: Provides smooth scrolling utilities that account for dynamic header height.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp chat URLs for the business with optional encoded messages.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended theme colors, layout settings, and custom animations using multiple plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, architecture notes, required images, and existing feature requirements for building an electrician services website.
